scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Modelled tank delivery versus measured inventory removal
entries.method: Request calibrated tank inventory and flow histories over a matched release interval, recording retained water, leaks and other transfers and synchronization error.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The model deliveredT field records tank bookkeeping, not target deposition. A different mass boundary, unsynchronized interval or uncounted transfer invalidates comparison.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Actual outlet flow and droplet/source distribution
entries.units: kg/s; m3/s; drop diameter m; m/s; geometry m; s
entries.method: Request matched outlet discharge, droplet-size/velocity distribution, nozzle/outlet geometry and tank state with calibration and uncertainty; identify any concurrent rotor/wake observations.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Configured intake-capacity benchmark and tank mean are not measured outlet flow. Ideal-disc air-flow comparison does not establish a spray distribution or wake.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Release geometry and atmospheric transport context
entries.units: m AGL; m MSL; m/s vector; kg/m3; K; Pa; humidity fraction; s
entries.method: Request release position/height, terrain and vegetation reference, trajectory/time, vertical and horizontal winds, atmosphere and heat/updraft context on a registered coordinate basis.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Fixed-diameter, no-updraft sensitivities and stipulated uniform wind are not a deposition model. A mismatched AGL reference, varying wind, evaporation, fragmentation or plume prevents direct transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Water reaching the target and its spatial pattern
entries.existing_model_reference: delivery.json classes.coverageLevelBySwath/lineKmAtCL; sim/plan.js geometric line predicate
entries.units: kg/m2; m2; position m; timestamp; s
entries.method: Request georeferenced calibrated collector/deposition records with target geometry, interval, sampling completeness and uncertainty; tie each sample to the same release and distinguish water elsewhere or lost in transport.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Geometric swath/coverage quotients and an in-perimeter line do not observe ground deposition. Incomplete sampling or a different release/target basis prevents inference from tank tonnage.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Measured fire effect and ground-engagement context
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 12 AFUE discussion; docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md operations-evaluator question
entries.units: declared outcome units UNKNOWN; observation interval s; location; categorical context
entries.method: Request a separately defined fire-effect metric, evaluation interval, fire/weather/fuel state, concurrent ground engagement and outcome provenance; retain comparison design and uncertainty without selecting a threshold.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Tank tonnage or deposition alone does not establish fire effect. Published literature association is not this vehicle evidence or a causal estimate; unequal fire/ground conditions invalidate transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Aligned record identities, uncertainty and complete evidence boundary
entries.units: record identity; calibration identity; timestamp; interval s; uncertainty units per measured quantity
entries.method: Request article/component identities, raw records, instrument calibration, coordinate/time transformations, sampling and missing-data flags, uncertainty derivation and an explicit chain linking tank, outlet, pattern and effect.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A summary value without matched calibration, identities, raw data or shared time/space basis cannot bridge model bookkeeping, target delivery and operational effect.
